title: ActivityDefinition
description: A finalized, immutable learner task (ADR-0007, ADR-0014). Hand-written and generated Definitions have this same shape, for every generation timing. Identity is id + document hash (defs.json#/$defs/document_hash), which activity.started records. The reference solution is a separate document bound here by path + hash, so it is never serialized with the activity. Only title, activity_type, skills, difficulty, instructions, hints and remediation may reach the learner or the tutor in hint mode (whitelist).

activity_type.description: Kind of task, e.g. inspect / diagnose / repair / explain. Open token; the core does not branch on it.

origin.description: Authored by hand, or produced by the generation path from a Template (ADR-0014).

hints.description: Progressive hints, least revealing first. Learner-facing; must not contain the full fix.

environment.description: EnvironmentDefinition id. Absent for activities without a lab.

tools.description: Tool adapters available to the learner, as adapter item ids (e.g. a terminal).

checks.description: Deterministic success checks: observations of environment facts, run by domain-adapter code; any command runs in the sandbox (ADR-0009, ADR-0013). The attempt succeeds only if all pass. Results feed evaluation.completed.checks.

reference_solution.description: The ReferenceSolution document. Withheld from the learner and from the tutor during an unfinished attempt (AC-J6).

then.description: A lab-backed activity must be verifiable before serving (AC-J2): at least one check and a reference solution.

check.description: Check registered by a domain adapter declared in the manifest, as '<adapter_id>.<name>'.
